description_en: Submits an asynchronous video text erasure task that supports full-area erasure, time ranges, and specified regions
description_zh: 提交异步视频文字擦除任务，支持整段擦除、时间范围和指定区域
name: SubmitVideoDetextJob

parameters.help_en: The input configuration JSON string. You must specify either VideoUrl or VideoMediaId, but not both
parameters.help_zh: 输入配置 JSON 字符串。VideoUrl 与 VideoMediaId 必须且只能提供一个
parameters.name: input

parameters.help_en: The output configuration JSON string. You can use OssUri to specify an OSS directory or an MP4 file path. The path cannot contain query parameters or fragments. If a directory is specified, detext.mp4 is automatically appended. If the path ends with .mp4 and has no trailing slash, it is used directly as the destination file. If OssUri is not specified, a signed URL for the processing result is returned in the query result
parameters.help_zh: 输出配置 JSON 字符串。OssUri 可指定 OSS 目录或 MP4 文件路径，不能包含 Query 参数或 Fragment；目录自动追加 detext.mp4，以 .mp4 结尾且无末尾 / 时直接作为目标文件。未指定时在查询结果中返回处理结果的签名 URL
parameters.name: output

parameters.help_en: The text erasure parameters JSON string. TextTargets is used to detect and erase text. FullEraseTargets is used to inpaint entire regions. EraseAllText only controls text filtering and does not expand the region. For parameters, default behaviors, and combination examples, see the supplementary description of request parameters
parameters.help_zh: 文字擦除参数 JSON 字符串。TextTargets 用于检测文字擦除，FullEraseTargets 用于整块区域修复；EraseAllText 仅控制文字筛选，不扩大区域。参数、默认行为及组合示例见请求参数补充说明
parameters.name: job_parameters

parameters.help_en: The custom data JSON string used for pass-through in final state notifications. For Message Service (MNS) callbacks, use NotifyAddress to specify the queue name prefixed with yike-callback, and use NotifyMnsEndpoint to specify the MNS endpoint of the same account. For HTTP or HTTPS callbacks, use NotifyAddress to specify the complete URL
parameters.help_zh: 自定义数据 JSON 字符串，用于终态通知透传。MNS 回调使用 NotifyAddress 指定以 yike-callback 为前缀的队列名称，使用 NotifyMnsEndpoint 指定同账号的 MNS 接入点；HTTP(S) 回调使用 NotifyAddress 指定完整地址
parameters.name: user_data

parameters.help_en: The user-level idempotency token. The token can be up to 40 characters in length. If the same user submits the request repeatedly with the same token, the original task is returned
parameters.help_zh: 用户维度的幂等令牌，最长 40 个字符。相同用户使用同一令牌重复提交时返回原任务
parameters.name: client_token

JobId.description_en: The video text erasure task ID, which is used to call GetVideoDetextJob to query the task
JobId.description_zh: 视频文字擦除任务 ID，用于调用 GetVideoDetextJob 查询任务
JobId.title_en: 视频字幕擦除任务 ID
JobId.title_zh: 视频字幕擦除任务 ID

RequestId.description_en: The request ID, which is used for Tracing Analysis and troubleshooting
RequestId.description_zh: 请求 ID，用于链路追踪和问题排查
